## Compliance Checklist
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets or credentials
- [ ] Error handling covers failure cases
- [ ] Logging added at service boundaries (no PII in logs)
- [ ] PII not exposed in responses or error messages
- [ ] Database migrations are reversible (up AND down tested)
- [ ] No breaking API changes (or versioned appropriately)
- [ ] Feature flag wrapped (if partial rollout)
- [ ] POPIA: new PII collection has consent mechanism
- [ ] Accessibility: keyboard navigable, screen reader tested (if UI)
